channel.title: Refrigerated & Frozen Foods - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Refrigerated & Frozen Foods (refrigeratedfrozenfood.com)

item.title: Turkey Hill Delivers Soft-Serve Inspired Frozen Desserts
item.description: Featuring classic fan favorite flavors like Vanilla and Chocolate & Vanilla Twist, these premium quality frozen desserts scoop easily right from the freezer for a perfectly smooth, creamy, soft-serve-like experience in every bite.

item.title: Lamb Weston Announces Leadership Changes
item.description: The Lamb Weston board of directors has appointed Jan Craps executive chair, effective February 6. James (Jim) D. Gray will join as chief financial officer (CFO).

item.title: Boar's Head Reopens Virginia Facility with Upgraded Food Safety
item.description: The milestone follows a comprehensive series of facility enhancements and enhanced product manufacturing protocols.

item.title: Doughlicious Debuts Cookies & Cream Skillet Cookie at Whole Foods
item.description: Designed for easy at-home preparation, Doughlicious skillet cookies go from freezer into the oven (or microwave) in minutes, making them ideal for dinner parties, celebrations, or cozy nights in.

item.title: Arctic Cold, REC Solar Adding 3.3MW Rooftop Array to California Storage Site
item.description: The solar system will offset over 80% of the facility’s energy needs annually.

item.title: Del Real Foods Expands Pupusas Line
item.description: The new pupusa features stone-ground masa filled with seasoned chipotle chicken and Oaxaca cheese.

item.title: Pre Brands Launches Protein-Packaging Refresh
item.description: The proprietary, patented packaging uses a clean, white chipboard base paired with a clear, 360° viewing window that allows shoppers to see the quality of the beef from every angle, delivering immediate clarity in a competitive category where nutrition cues matter more than ever.

item.title: Prairie Fresh, Garozzo’s Bring Iconic Italian Sausage to KC Groceries
item.description: Prairie Fresh partnered with Garozzo’s Ristorante for a collaboration between the two local brands to launch Garozzo’s Italian Style Ground Sausage, crafted with the same signature seasoning blend that has made Garozzo’s Ristorante a staple since 1989.

item.title: Chef Robotics, Packline Partner on End-to-End Meal Production Automation
item.description: Chef Robotics, a leader in AI-enabled robotic systems for food assembly, and Packline Solutions Group, announced a strategic partnership to offer an integrated food manufacturing automation solution for flexible meal assembly and packaging.

item.title: IPPE ’26 Sets Show Floor Record
item.description: With over 660,000 square feet of exhibit space and 1,300+ exhibitors, it marked the largest show floor in IPPE’s history.
